visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A large flat-screen TV occupies the center of the frame, displaying a professional fashion runway show. A female model with long dark hair, wearing a light blue lingerie set and an ornate silver crown, walks confidently toward the camera. The stage environment is brightly lit with vibrant purple and blue spotlights, creating a high-contrast cinematic atmosphere. (2) The scene cuts to a young girl inside a domestic living room. She is wearing a white polo shirt with red collar and sleeve trim. She directly faces the camera and raises both arms to strike a modeling pose, placing her hands behind her head while looking focused. The room is brightly lit, showing a white storage cabinet and various small objects in the background. (3) The camera returns to the TV screen, showing another model with large, feathery orange and red wings walking away from the camera. The runway is sleek and reflective, with bright pink and blue lighting. (4) The girl is shown again, now sitting on the floor of the living room. She stretches her arms high above her head and arches her back, mimicking the dramatic 'winged' silhouette of the models seen on screen. A laptop and snacks are visible on a table nearby. (5) A final cut to the TV shows a model in a vibrant pink outfit on the runway. The girl then appears in a side-profile view, smiling and laughing joyfully while striking a confident pose, successfully mimicking the professional poise of the runway models.
